findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (roll call 758)
findings.note: House passed 66 to 47; Belk is listed among the Noes. The bill, as summarised by legislative staff, would have required counties to process a registration only if the applicant states they are a citizen (an applicant who leaves it blank gets a form to sign under penalty of perjury), required DMV to send full Social Security numbers to the State Board of Elections, and set up a process to remove non-citizens found in a federal database from the voter rolls. It was vetoed by the Governor on 2026-08-17. Summary source: https://www.ncleg.gov/Legislation/Bills/Summaries/2025/H958 (staff summary of Part II dated 2026-08-19).

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Motion 11 to concur in the Senate committee substitute (roll call 801)
findings.note: House concurred 62 to 47; Belk is listed among the Noes. This is the final House vote before the bill went to the Governor, who vetoed it on 2026-08-17.
